name: Mus
summary: Four-player partnership vying game with a 40-card Spanish deck where teams bet on high, low, pairs and total.
rules_text: Mus is played by 4 in two fixed partnerships sitting opposite, counter-clockwise, first to 40 stones wins. Deal 4 cards each from a 40-card Spanish deck, mano is to dealer's right. In Mus phase, starting with mano each says Mus or No hay Mus. If all say Mus, each discards 1-4 face down and draws replacements from deck, reshuffling discards if needed; repeat until any player refuses. Then four betting rounds in order Grande, Chica, Pares, Juego/Punto. Grande = highest card lexically, Chica = lowest. Pares = one pair, three of a kind, or two pairs, four of a kind counts as two pairs. Juego = sum of values (R/3/C/S=10, 7=7,6=6,5=5,4=4,A/2=1) ; 31 is best game, then 32,40,37,36,35,34,33; under 31 is no game and competes for Punto. In each round players may pass or bet at least 2. Opponents may fold (bettor gets 1 stone), see (winner later takes stake), or raise by >=2. Ordago may wager the whole match on a round. At showdown compare best hand of each side for each round not folded and award stakes plus bonus stones for Pares and Juego if not bet.
